verdict.rationale: Ollama runs a server with a REST API (gh-4), documented local base URLs (docs-9) and OpenAI-compatible endpoints (docs-12), so other clients can call it over HTTP. A community user's mention of connecting to a 'remote Ollama instance' implies people do run it across machines (comm-17). Nothing in the pack documents exposing the server beyond localhost or securing it for LAN access. Missing for 10: documented network binding or host configuration for LAN exposure, guidance on access control or security for remote devices, hands-on corroboration of multi-device access.
